milestones.2022: Budget 2022 Duty-Free CBU Exemption takes effect; EV registrations cross 3,000.
milestones.2023: BYD Atto 3 volume deliveries; NETR targets 10,000 charging bays by 2025.
milestones.2024: Tesla launches Model 3 & Model Y deliveries; BYD Seal reaches volume scale.
milestones.2025: Mainstream adoption expands; Chery Omoda E5 and corporate EV fleets launch.
milestones.2026: National OEM era arrives: Proton e.MAS 7 surges to the #1 EV position in Malaysia.
milestones.all: 2022–2026 Electrification Transition: From luxury niche to national mass-market mobility.
